name: ModernUO
adapter: implemented; validate against your selected deployment
setup: Build with the pinned launchers/shard tools, then use tools/editor_shard setup for an isolated distribution. Configure Configuration/modernuo.json listeners and dataDirectories.

lab.toolchain: .NET SDK 10.0.201 (global.json, rollForward latestMajor), net10.0; Windows, Linux, macOS

admin.detail: MUO patch 0001-headless-owner-account creates or raises UO_SHARD_OWNER from UO_SHARD_OWNER_PASSWORD at every boot

name: ServUO
adapter: implemented: all seven server sections (tile light/animation fields refused); compiled and runtime-probed; live GUO gameplay pending
setup: Use tools/servuo/run.py fetch, build and configure for the existing private backend. For another instance copy its built distribution to a separate folder; configure Config/Server.cfg and client data.

lab.toolchain: .NET SDK (dotnet build of SDK-style net48 projects); runs on .NET Framework 4.8, Windows only

client.accepts: 7.0.x classic; ClientVerification reads the required version from the client.exe in the data folder (LenientKick below it)

admin.detail: first boot asks on stdin for an owner account; tools/servuo start answers it from UO_SHARD_OWNER / UO_SHARD_OWNER_PASSWORD

name: RunUO
adapter: implemented: all seven server sections (tile light/animation fields refused); compiled and runtime-probed; live GUO gameplay pending
setup: Build the upstream solution with its documented .NET Framework toolchain. Configure its server-list/listener and data paths, then create the initial administrator account.

name: POL
adapter: implemented: item definitions, explicit reserved object types; native config parser tested; other sections refused
setup: Obtain/build the upstream core and a compatible POL distribution. Configure pol.cfg, realms, scripts and accounts; compile the realm from your own UO data.

name: Sphere X
adapter: implemented: item definitions; native item creation tested; other sections refused
setup: Obtain/build Source-X and the compatible Scripts-X script pack. Configure sphere.ini server address, port and local client data paths; create an administrator account.

lab.pin_source: SV0; the adapter probe ran a nightly build without a recorded commit, and the repo's Nightly tag is from 2022
lab.toolchain: CMake 3.29 or newer, a C++20 compiler (Visual Studio 2022 on Windows), MariaDB client library (lib/bin in the repo on Windows)

client.accepts: any supported client while sphere.ini ClientVersion stays commented out
client.encryption: sphere.ini UseCrypt=1, UseNoCrypt=0 by default; the lab must set UseNoCrypt=1

era.upstream_default: T2A features only (FeatureT2A=01|02, the rest 0); era limits 9 (ToL)
era.lab: upstream default; AOS-era cases such as tooltips may be n/a

admin.detail: accounts/sphereacct.scp section [name] with PLEVEL=7 and PASSWORD, written by the lab before first boot; console alternative ACCOUNT <name> PLEVEL 7. AccApp=0 by default (2 = free auto accounts)

bind.detail: sphere.ini ServIP is the bound address (CServer.cpp binds m_ip); the experimental ping server (EF_UsePingServer, UDP 12000, 0.0.0.0) stays off

name: UOX3
adapter: implemented: item definitions; native item creation tested; other sections refused
setup: Obtain a release or build make/VS2022/uox3.sln with C++ tools. Keep its data/scripts with the executable; configure uox.ini, client data and an administrator account.

lab.pin_source: the release the adapter probe ran (tools/server_adapters/README.md); v0.99.7d (a1fee724, 2026-08-13, branch develop) is newer and moves only with an adapter re-probe
lab.toolchain: MSVC v143 (Visual Studio 2022, make/VS2022/uox3.sln), C++17; CMake (make/cmake) on Linux and macOS; SpiderMonkey and zlib are in the repo

client.accepts: about 4.0.0 to 7.0.109.0, unencrypted only (README); uox.ini [clientsupport] CLIENTSUPPORT70610=1 is the only band on by default

era.setting: uox.ini CORESHARDERA (core, uo, t2a, uor, td, lbr, aos, se, ml, sa, hs, tol)
era.lab: lbr (upstream default; later-era cases may be n/a)

admin.detail: data/accounts/accounts.adm ships admin/admin with the GM flag 0x8000; the lab rewrites it with a generated password before first boot and never runs the shipped default. INTERNALACCOUNTCREATION=1 makes player accounts on first login

bind.detail: network.cpp binds INADDR_ANY; EXTERNALIP only sets the advertised address. SV5 needs a local patch or a firewall block rule before the lab starts it
